name: Smooth Domain Warp for Volumetric Clouds
definition: A technique to eliminate repetitive tiling artifacts in volumetric cloud fields by applying a smooth domain warp to every noise read, ensuring the cloud field does not repeat at the original noise periods.
summary: Smooth Domain Warp eliminates repetitive tiling in volumetric clouds by applying a fixed, large-period sine-based warp carried by wind, avoiding the unwanted shear caused by procedural noise-driven warping.
